meta.promptText: I want to buy a sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast on Indian skin. Which one is best?

response.text:
For Indian skin tones, especially medium, dusky, and deeper skin, I'd look for a sunscreen that is **SPF 50, broad-spectrum, and specifically known for leaving little to no white cast**\. Lightweight gel, fluid, and well-formulated chemical sunscreens are often good choices.

One important distinction: a sunscreen can look invisible on fair skin but leave a grey or ashy finish on deeper skin, so the finish matters just as much as the SPF.

## My top picks in India

![Buy The Derma Co. 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel SPF 50 PA++++ (30g) Online at Best Price in India on Tira Website & App](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Md698EAP_zA83ptOSOFSFV8vEHK7_cqMhaAuYn9olwMUkxBZSgAT_001HIuFlfy_MX7jNXGDhACOWTSEBr86QdD38HyMoizIyK32FbZqlLNsul9S_ESvwhDhgJ3nSRJSJWqOc7614P4YbCQYnzbUaQlaDjHaftDM-aBBj4V4Fd-oYqjpS3IVNs_1Qo8bZZ1X?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel SPF 50 PA++++**

(Best overall starting point)

Approx. ₹400–₹450

A lightweight gel-style option for everyday wear. Worth trying if you want a comfortable finish without an obvious white cast. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/these-7-sunscreens-without-white-cast-work-for-indian-skin-and-summers-101783583467308.html/)[www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/health/best-sunscreens-without-a-white-cast-7-picks-for-a-natural-finish-and-sensitive-skin-101769770915580-amp.html)

Best for: normal, combination or oily skin.

---



**2\. Minimalist Light Fluid SPF 50 Face Sunscreen**

Around ₹474 on the listed retailer

A fluid-format alternative if you prefer a thinner sunscreen over a thicker cream. A reasonable option to compare for daily use.

Best for: people who prefer lightweight textures.

[Minimalist official website](https://beminimalist.co/)

---

![Buy Ultra Matte Dry Touch Sunscreen Gel SPF 50 PA++++ – Re'equil](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LUZ8SLyVS0XvrPWdbIKk5ioJUUGOiT_SSCYNaS-XvotJOZVknD8iPDkdTfSSVyZCAR-9AquJ8pYVPLPnf1oa9jeX_jqRTthGsEpznau6ktgWtbd0xOGt4PiYr0iXuSZ397-z0KntRxM75hXwk9r3tlTryXYnAn15nqVhjy10NSKJVxY7pgAGI3OU08BsO_tf?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Re'equil Ultra Matte Dry Touch Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++**

A matte-finish option to consider if your face gets shiny in Mumbai's humidity. It may feel less dewy than gel or hydrating formulas. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/these-7-sunscreens-without-white-cast-work-for-indian-skin-and-summers-101783583467308.html)[sahipick.com](https://sahipick.com/skincare/best-sunscreens-india-2026/)

Best for: oily skin and people who prefer a matte finish.

[Re'equil official website](https://www.reequil.com/)

---



**4\. Cetaphil Sun SPF 50 Light Gel**

Around ₹1,104 on the listed retailer

A more premium-priced alternative if you prefer a facial sunscreen from a skincare-focused brand. Check the current formula and finish before buying if zero white cast is your priority.

Best for: comparing a higher-priced daily-use option.

Prices can vary by retailer and offers. These are shortlist recommendations, not a guarantee that every formula will be invisible on every skin tone.

## Which one should you buy?

My first pick would be **The Derma Co Aqua Gel SPF 50** if you want an affordable, lightweight sunscreen. If your skin is very oily and you dislike shine, try Re'equil's matte formula instead.

A few buying tips\:

- Choose SPF 50 with strong UVA protection, ideally PA++++.
- Apply generously and reapply about every two hours when outdoors, and after swimming or heavy sweating.
- If you have a deeper skin tone, test the sunscreen on your jawline in daylight to check for any grey or ashy residue.

search_results.description: Amazon’s October Prime Day 2026, held on October 6-7, offers a massive two-day beauty sale featuring deep discounts of up to 50% on top-rated items. This guide by Who What Wear highlights 43 standout deals across skincare, haircare, makeup, bodycare, fragrance, and wellness products. Featured discounts include editor-approved essentials like French pharmacy must-haves from Avène, K-beauty products such as Anua's moisturizing cream, and trending items like vitamin C serums, LED masks, and retinoid creams. Popular fragrance deals include scents loved by celebrities, while wellness deals range from melatonin-infused gummies to teeth-whitening kits. Haircare favorites like the Shark FlexStyle, Ouai leave-in conditioner, and Oribe wax stick are also significantly marked down. Makeup deals cover bestselling brow pencils, illuminating skin tints, and celebrity-favorite mascaras. To access these deals, shoppers must have an active Amazon Prime membership. Designed with guidance from industry professionals, this curated selection promises high-performing products suitable for various budgets and beauty routines.

search_results.title: I've switched my routine to Korean skincare - these 11 products left me GLOWING
search_results.description: A beauty expert from The Sun tested an array of Korean skincare products for over a month and reported remarkable improvements in skin hydration, clarity, and texture, leading to a glowing ‘glass skin’ effect. Korean skincare is praised for its innovative, science-backed formulations with a preventative approach to skin concerns. Eleven standout products were reviewed, including Medicube No Cast Just Glow Collagen Sunscreen (10/10 for sun protection and glow), Beauty of Joseon’s Eye Serum (9.5/10 for brightening and anti-aging), and the Medicube Night Wrapping Mask (9.5/10 for plump, hydrated skin). Other high-rated picks include SKIN1004 Centella Ampoule, Medicube Zero Pore Pads, and ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Serum, each tailored for hydration, repairing the skin barrier, and soothing inflammation. COSRX Snail Mucin, Dr Jart+ Moisturising Cream, and Mediheal Moisture Pads further impressed with their hydrating and rejuvenating effects. Products generally performed well across different skin types, including sensitive skin. The article highlights where to shop for K-beauty in the UK, emphasizing accessibility and value through retailer bundles and advent calendars. Overall, the author's switch to K-beauty resulted in improved skin health and radiance.
